mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.5% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy tightens.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers market anticipation of strong corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5%) and monthly housing starts (HOUST > 1300 thousand units) indicate robust economic expansion, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 > 0.5% and HOUST > 1300 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, an unemployment rate below 3.5% signals overheating and impending aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 680,000 million dollars) indicate robust consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 680,000 million dollars fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 100,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS monthly change exceeds 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate above 5.0% and CPI index above 300 indicate a monetary tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 300 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In an early recession regime, industrial production below 100 signals weakening economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of early recession periods when INDPRO is below 100.
